critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with proper separation of concerns
Auth implementation uses httpOnly cookies correctly
Bcrypt password hashing is properly implemented
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
API responses properly serialize MongoDB ObjectId to string
seed_data_creation: Seed data includes: 10 products, 5 clients, 3 suppliers, 15+ sales, 10 financial entries, 3 plans (Starter, Professional, Enterprise), 1 tenant (Empresa Demo Ltda), 1 license
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 apps fully functional. Admin Master at /admin, Web SaaS at /app, PDV at /pdv. Each has separate login. JWT auth with httpOnly cookies. Portuguese (BR) language throughout.
